skill.name: ai-partner-chat
skill.description: Provides personalized, context-aware conversations using user personas, project notes, conversation history, and local vector search.
skill.summary: Turn project notes and chat history into a local long-term memory for AI conversations.
skill.author: Cz07cring

security_audit.summary: Most static command detections are false positives from Markdown code fences, documentation, normal imports, and safe local cache paths. Confirmed risks include persistent storage of conversations, notes, tags, emotion data, and vector data under hidden home directories, plus temporary backup of skill data during installation. Semantic review also found remote model loading with trusted code enabled, default conversation logging, and opaque reuse of stored personal context.

remediation.issue: Remote model code execution is enabled during embedding model loading.
remediation.suggestion: Remove trust_remote_code=True, pin a reviewed model revision, and document the model source and download behavior.

remediation.issue: Conversation logging is enabled as the default workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Make logging opt-in, show a clear consent prompt, and provide an easy per-session disable command.

remediation.issue: Personal notes, conversations, tags, and emotion timelines are retained in hidden local storage.
remediation.suggestion: Add retention controls, deletion commands, encryption guidance, and a clear data inventory in the README and SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: The installer backs up user memory data into /tmp.
remediation.suggestion: Use mktemp with restrictive permissions or keep backups inside the skill data directory with explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: The persona template discourages transparent disclosure when answers use stored records.
remediation.suggestion: Remove that guidance and require clear language when a reply uses stored notes or conversation history.

content.user_title: Build a Personalized AI Memory Partner
content.value_statement: Users lose useful context when notes and conversations stay separate. This skill builds local memory from notes, chats, tags, and vector search.
actual_capabilities: Processes Markdown notes and stores searchable chunks in a local vector database.
Extracts code blocks from notes and records language, dependencies, and function metadata.
Logs conversations to dated Markdown files and indexes important conversations.
Generates topic tags, emotion state, and thinking-level metadata for learning notes.
Retrieves related notes, conversations, and code snippets for context-aware replies.
Creates weekly learning and conversation summary files from stored local data.
limitations: Requires Python dependencies and may download a large embedding model on first use.
Stores personal notes and conversations on disk, so users must manage retention and privacy.
Does not provide a hosted chat service or model API by itself.
Several analysis steps are rule-based unless the user extends them with an LLM.

use_cases.title: Recall Learning Notes
use_cases.description: Index study notes so future Claude or Codex sessions can retrieve relevant explanations and examples.
use_cases.target_user: Developers and students building long-term technical memory.

use_cases.title: Preserve Project Conversations
use_cases.description: Save important AI conversations and reuse them as context for later planning or debugging sessions.
use_cases.target_user: Engineers who work across multiple coding sessions.

use_cases.title: Review Learning Progress
use_cases.description: Summarize recent notes, tags, emotions, and thinking depth into a weekly learning report.
use_cases.target_user: Self-directed learners and mentors tracking progress.

prompt_templates.title: Start Local Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up AI Partner Chat for this project. Explain what data it will store and where it will be stored before doing anything.

prompt_templates.title: Process New Notes
prompt_templates.scenario: Index project notes after editing them.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my project notes for new or changed Markdown files, process only those files, and summarize what was added to memory.

prompt_templates.title: Answer With Memory
prompt_templates.scenario: Use stored context during a coding or learning question.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my local AI Partner Chat memory to answer this question. Show which notes or conversations influenced the answer in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Stored Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the stored AI Partner Chat memory for this project. Identify stale, sensitive, duplicate, or low-value entries and recommend cleanup steps.

output_examples.input: I added React Hooks notes. Please process them.
output_examples.output: The skill reports that it found updated notes, extracted React-related tags, indexed code examples, and updated the local memory store.

output_examples.input: What did we decide about state updates last week?
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes relevant prior conversations and notes, then explains the remembered decision in normal text.
The skill creates a report with note counts, top topics, thinking-level distribution, and learning suggestions.

best_practices: Ask for explicit consent before enabling automatic conversation logging.
Keep sensitive notes out of the indexed notes directory unless they are needed.
Review and clean the local data directory on a regular schedule.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill on shared machines without a retention and access policy.
Do not index secrets, credentials, private keys, or confidential customer data.
Do not hide when an answer uses stored personal context.

faq.question: Does this skill send my notes to a remote server?
faq.answer: The code stores notes and conversations locally in ChromaDB. The embedding model may be downloaded from an external model source.

faq.question: Can I stop conversation logging?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill instructions include a skip path when the user asks not to record, but default logging should be changed to opt-in.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data does it store?
faq.answer: It can store notes, conversations, tags, emotion timelines, reports, and vector database entries.

faq.question: Does it generate AI replies by itself?
faq.answer: No. It prepares and retrieves context. A separate AI assistant still generates the final response.

faq.question: What is the main security concern?
faq.answer: The main concern is persistent local storage of personal context, plus remote model loading with trusted code enabled.
